    The concrete right-module Auslander transpose copresentation #

    For a two-step minimal projective presentation P₁ ⟶ P₀ ⟶ X, the Nakayama kernel ker(nu P₁ ⟶ nu P₀) embeds in the injective module nu P₁. This file packages the resulting short injective presentation and its pullback-natural quotient description of degree-one Ext.
